tagline: Quality outdoor power equipment for Auckland homes and gardens
heroSubheading: We supply and service outdoor power equipment for Mt Albert and beyond.
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Mt Albert, run by Hamish Cook and Clare Uhlenberg. We specialise in outdoor power equipment for Auckland gardens, farms, and properties. We stock STIHL, Masport, Rover, Cub Cadet, and Honda Power Equipment, along with the full range of accessories you need.

We sell, service, and repair outdoor power equipment. When you order online and choose Click & Collect, we assemble your machine and have it ready to go so you can start your project straightaway. Pop in and talk to us about what you need. We're here to help you find the right equipment for the job and look after it whenever it needs attention.

Call in and see us Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, and Saturday and Sunday, 9am to 3pm.
whatMakesUsSpecial: Machines assembled and ready when you collect
